title: Mobile Imaging Solutions for Medical Diagnosis: Trends and Applications
abstract: arXiv:2609.24814v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Advances in processing power, camera technologies, and mobile image analysis have made smartphones and other mobile devices, such as laptops, increasingly suitable for medical diagnosis and healthcare applications. Researchers have developed low-cost solutions for the early detection and monitoring of various health conditions, including eye and ENT diseases, malnutrition, heart rate variability, skin and oral conditions, and injuries, using images captured by non-medical devices such as smartphones and webcams. This survey examines existing research on mobile image-based medical diagnosis, with an emphasis on its potential to enable low-cost and accessible healthcare. We comparatively analyze state-of-the-art solutions across different healthcare application categories, examining their advantages and limitations. translated_title: 面向医学诊断的移动成像解决方案：趋势与应用
translated_abstract: 处理能力、相机技术和移动图像分析的进步，使得智能手机和其他移动设备（如笔记本电脑）越来越适用于医学诊断和医疗保健应用。研究人员已开发出低成本的解决方案，利用智能手机和网络摄像头等非医疗设备拍摄的图像，对多种健康状况进行早期检测和监测，包括眼部和耳鼻喉疾病、营养不良、心率变异性、皮肤和口腔状况以及外伤等。本综述考察了基于移动图像的医学诊断领域的现有研究，重点在于其实现低成本、可及性医疗保健的潜力。我们对不同医疗保健应用类别中最先进的解决方案进行了比较分析，考察了它们的优势与局限性。基于这一分析，我们确定了基于移动图像的诊断工具应具备的理想特性，并指出了相关领域亟待发展的方向。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了基于智能手机等非医疗设备图像的医学诊断研究，比较了各类医疗应用中最先进解决方案的优势与局限，展现了移动成像技术在实现低成本、可及性医疗保健方面的巨大潜力。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews mobile image-based medical diagnosis research using smartphones and other non-medical devices, comparatively analyzes state-of-the-art solutions across healthcare application categories, and highlights the potential of mobile imaging for enabling low-cost and accessible healthcare.
